blocks.title: Stack
blocks.text: Stack aisa data structure hai jis mein cheezein sirf ek sire, top, se jori aur hatayi jati hain. Yeh Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) usool par chalta hai: sab se aakhir mein judi cheez sab se pehle hatti hai.

blocks.prompt: Stack ki tareef kijiye aur LIFO usool samjhaiye (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Stack aisa majmooa hai jis mein dakhila (push) aur hatana (pop) sirf top par hota hai. LIFO ka matlab aakhir mein push hone wali cheez pehle pop hoti hai, jaise plates ka dher jahan aap oopar wali plate uthate hain, jo aakhir mein rakhi gayi thi.

items: Stack: ek khula sira (top); Last-In, First-Out.
